> I have decided that I will be designing from scratch a tray that I can mount on the side of my desk in freeCAD.  I have never used freeCAD before but that just makes this project more exiting and rewarding in the long run! The tray will have three rectangular cutouts that I can put my screws/ small tools/ screwdriver heads... I also want this to feature a hook at the end of it for my headphones.

### 2026-10-16 – I have installed freeCAD and was immediately overwhelmed by all the options, buttons and tools at my disposal, so I closed it back and opened a handy 3 hour guide for newbies on freeCAD 1.1.

**7h**

I have installed freeCAD and was immediately overwhelmed by all the options, buttons and tools at my disposal, so I closed it back and opened a handy 3 hour guide for newbies on freeCAD 1.1.
